'''September 2000 St. Cloud tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at St. Cloud State University (Atwood Center), St. Cloud, Minnesota on 23 September 2000. [[Michael Raveling]] won it. It is known from Robert Parker's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1266">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-24-saint-cloud-minnesota-9-23-00d1266/ saint-cloud-minnesota-9-23-00], DeckTech (Robert "Sparky" Parker, 24 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-24-saint-cloud-minnesota-9-23-00d1266/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 23 September 2000
* '''Site:''' St. Cloud State University (Atwood Center), St. Cloud, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Raveling]]
